items.title: Charlie Gabriel interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: I didn’t replace him, in other words I played the solo after the Illinois Jacquet

ctx.x: I didn’t replace him, in other words I played the solo after the Illinois Jacquet and so it gave me a little chance to try and be with that band. But I didn’t stay with that band at all. I just did a couple of things with them while they were in the City of Detroit.
